differentSettings.conditioning: Official single pipeline.run with one exact front versus native run_mv with three posed views fused by average
differentSettings.weights: Single and MV checkpoints differ; equal integer seed does not imply an equivalent random process.
differentSettings.preprocessing: Each official entrypoint retains its own preprocessing. Single preprocess_image may recenter/crop before conditioning; MV uses its official posed-view loader. Input file pixels are identical, not a claim of identical internal tensors.
differentSettings.camera: Single uses the same supplied20-degree manual FOV and official inferred distance; MV uses the recorded assumed orbit matrices. No new calibrated camera is claimed.

evaluation: Original four-side geometry completeness with identical normalized framing
Same mobile triangle/texture budget and postprocess comparison
Total generation and downstream processing wall time

timingPolicy.generation: Separate process bootstrap/loading, native stage telemetry and4096 export; report total run_part wall time. Resource waits are separate attempts and excluded from inference comparison.
timingPolicy.baseline: Use existing MV stage log; disclose any prior-source export replay or CPU load differences rather than treating total time as controlled hardware benchmark.
timingPolicy.postprocess: Record CPU derivation, UV/field replay, render/review time separately. Do not compare only the fastest successful stage.

limitations: One paired sample cannot prove overall single-view or multiview superiority.
Unseen single-view sides are inferred and may differ from the design.
This output is excluded from canonical candidates, approvals and release bundles.
